g.text: THE PARTS THAT BREAK TEACH THE MOST
React StrictMode + uncleaned Lenis listener → wheel events intercepted → scroll fails
preloaded mp4 ≠ runtime webm → duplicate download → unnecessary bandwidth
local env worked, deployed runtime did not → configuration belongs to the deployment too
deprecation / integration issues → inspect the actual runtime path, not just the source
LESSON: lifecycle bugs can look like hardware/browser problems.
LESSON: performance starts with knowing exactly what the browser is downloading.
LESSON: trace the data from source → build → runtime → user.
